title: Enterprise Digital Performance SME (Strategic Workforce Planning)
summary: Digital transformation of strategic workforce planning at division HQ — machine-learning forecasting, preventive maintenance analytics, and the data infrastructure that makes them work.
achievements: Drive the digital transformation of strategic workforce planning for a global division, acting as focal point to the Division HR Director and advisor to divisional stakeholders on digital performance topics.

Lead the design and deployment of machine-learning headcount demand forecasting tied to activity and revenue, taking the use case from ideation and prototyping through to adoption in financial planning cycles.

Designed the concept for an ML-based preventive maintenance tool for field equipment: standardized the failure-investigation process flow across different tool types, each with its own way of working, and mapped them to the electronic boards where temperature and pressure degradation is sensed — using internal board sensors as the design differentiator.

Solved the data problem behind it: five years of historical failure data that mostly had to be computed to exist, plus upgrades to acquisition software and real-time transmission through our remote-operations infrastructure to the virtual processing unit hosting the ML model, so failures are detected live during acquisition instead of after the fact.

Design activity-to-headcount demand metrics and analytics products (Power BI / DAX fact models) integrating multiple enterprise source systems, giving leadership forward visibility on resourcing demand.
Develop KPOs and KPIs standardizing governance of workforce planning and performance across geographic units, and monitor implementation risks with mitigation measures.
Coordinate location workforce managers across the division through financial planning and execution cycles, aligning digital initiatives with budget and strategic objectives.

title: Field Development & Engagement Manager
summary: People strategy for an 800-person GeoUnit across Oman and Pakistan during a period of rapid expansion, pairing organizational design with digital tools that carried measurable ROI.
achievements: Primary point of contact for people planning, development, and performance across the GeoUnit (800 headcount); led a team of two HRBPs and three staffing coordinators while holding dual GeoUnit and HQ strategic roles.
Led workforce strategy through rapid expansion: 21% topline growth, ~1,000 bps IBT improvement, and three consecutive injury-free years.

Built digital fleet deployment tools for sub-business-line managers that saved three headcounts per fleet and improved employee utilization by ~250 bps per fleet — a digital solution with direct, measured ROI.

Reviewed organization structures across three business lines, identifying 7% underutilized capability and improving organizational effectiveness by 3%; achieved 50% reduction in CMSr through operational optimization.
Resolved contractor onboarding misalignments, saving $1.5K per contractor, and published service-delivery metrics that lifted the employee engagement index.

title: Workforce Coordinator
summary: Workforce analytics and staffing for 815 people across six sub-segments, supporting delivery on Shell and BP awarded contracts.
achievements: Delivered quarterly compensation, utilization, and gap analytics for 815 personnel across six sub-segments; introduced a bi-weekly balanced scorecard improving real-time decision-making by 17%.
Used PMO tools to track projects against milestones and KPIs, proactively flagging risks and mitigation measures to the Division Manager.
Led four recruiting specialists to close 87% of staffing gaps on Shell and BP awarded contracts; cut time-to-autonomy 19% and Time-to-Full-Autonomy 13% YoY through data-driven training redesign.
Drove cross-functional multi-skilling of fleet crews, delivering 11% compensation deployment savings.

title: Remote Operations Lead
summary: End-to-end delivery of a digital operating model: business case, prototype, then roll-out beyond Oman to four more countries. Recognized with a letter from SLB's CEO.
achievements: Spearheaded the commercialization of the Muscat Remote Operations Center, a digital operating model replacing on-site presence: diagnosed the previous showstoppers and delivered hands-on solutions to managing directors. Recognized with a letter from SLB's CEO.
Led client engagement and change management for remote-operations adoption, then scaled coverage beyond Oman to Egypt, Kuwait, Australia, and Malaysia.
Managed 8 engineers on a 24/7/365 model; built KPI-based procedures identifying strategic fleets to maximize coverage of critical service demand.
Analyzed center performance and customer satisfaction, driving continuous improvement of systems and processes; PDO Shukran Award 2021 for excellent and safe deployment of remote operations.

title: Field Engineer → Engineer in Charge, Wireline
summary: Seven years in the field — wireline exploration services for PDO/Shell, Occidental Petroleum and Petrogas, and first deployments of new SLB technologies.
achievements: Led wireline exploration services for PDO/Shell, Occidental Petroleum, and Petrogas; handpicked by PDO–Shell as lead engineer for fluid sampling and rock coring services.
Selected to introduce emerging SLB technologies (NT-1/NT-5 new-technology deployments): Saturn 12.25″ fluid sampling, NMR logging in fiberglass casing, low-pressure tubing cutters.
Increased operational productivity 19% on exploration services; led 6+ engineers and 30+ operators with a continuous-improvement culture.
